text: The City–East Coast Site-Specific Study (SSS) was completed in 2025 with detailed recommendations, costing S$18 million. The initiative is set to begin construction in the 2030s, aligning with urban regeneration timelines. Quantifiable hazard-reduction outcomes are not yet available due to the recent concept release.
